brief: A wall-hung spice rack: at least three bins, hung from keyhole hangers.

requirements.evidence: Three full-depth cells (piece at 0,0 / 1,0 / 0,-1) joined into a small cluster. I could not confirm from the configurator which face is the wall side, so the orientation against a wall is not verified; the keyholes sit on one outer face of each cell (slot 5 on two cells, slot 3 on the third).
Three hex-bin-full bins (bin:0,0,0, bin:1,0,0, bin:0,-1,0), one in each cell.
Three hex-acc-keyhole accessories (accessory:0#0,0#5, accessory:0#1,0#5, accessory:0#0,-1#3), one per cell. Check_build reports no issues and meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built a three-cell spice rack: three full-depth bins in a cluster of three cells, each cell with a keyhole hanger, open faces capped and joints locked. check_build is clean with meshClash clear. Caveat: I could not verify from the configurator which face is the mounting wall, so the wall alignment needs a check before mounting. No spice jars were added as props since the brief did not ask for them.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
